AVX-512 byte-vector constructors, bit ops, and load/store helpers.

# Purpose
This header defines the AVX-512 byte vector API for `wwb_t`, which maps to `__m512i` and stores 64 unsigned 8-bit values in one vector. It provides constructors such as `wwb`, `wwb_bcast`, [`wwb_bcast_pair`](<#wwb_bcast_pair>), [`wwb_bcast_quad`](<#wwb_bcast_quad>), [`wwb_bcast_oct`](<#wwb_bcast_oct>), and [`wwb_bcast_hex`](<#wwb_bcast_hex>) to build byte patterns, plus byte swap helpers like `wwb_exch_adj` and `wwb_exch_adj_pair`. The file also defines basic bitwise operations, shift helpers, and aligned and unaligned load and store functions for 64-byte memory blocks. The include guard and error check force users to include `fd_avx512.h` instead of including this file directly.
